Camille.build: If Camille W Tactical Sweep’s healing makes it hard to finish her, buy Executioner’s Calling early. Build armor first against Camille’s main damage. However, armor can’t reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and building a lot of health also increases the damage from Camille W Tactical Sweep, which scales with your maximum health.
Camille.combo: When going for a kill, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while the enemy is airborne, then recast it to finish after their health has decreased. Don’t press Riven Q Broken Wings repeatedly; land basic attacks between casts.
Camille.escape: When the stun from Camille E Hookshot is down, look for a chance to close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is also down, follow up with Riven W Ki Burst to lock her down and fight. If only Camille E Hookshot is down and her ultimate is still available, she can escape with another mobility spell, so engage carefully.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading just after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield. Once the shield has been removed, close in with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor. Stay close, stun her with Riven W Ki Burst, and weave in empowered basic attacks between spells.
Camille.laning: Early on, stand among minions and away from walls to limit Camille E Hookshot’s engage angles. Don’t use all of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; save one cast for a counterattack. Gain lane control and pressure her farming before Camille completes her first core item.
Camille.phase: From the mid game onward, Camille can quickly take down turrets in a side lane, so don’t leave the lane unattended. In the late game, Riven should choose her engage instead of blindly diving into the front line.
Camille.teamfight: Before engaging, make sure you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to escape with, and don’t waste Riven W Ki Burst as Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum engages.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses walls to engage from long range and stun you, so stand away from walls. If you see her hook, create distance with Riven Q Broken Wings or E Valor. Don’t use a response ability as Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum engages; if you’re trapped, wait out the zone’s duration, then counterattack.

Aurora.fight: Use Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor to get close and bait Aurora E The Weirding, then close the gap again with your remaining engage spell. Once you’re close, stun her with Riven W Ki Burst and weave in empowered basic attacks between spells. If Aurora uses W Across the Veil to become invisible, don’t waste spells; wait for her to reappear.
Aurora.teamfight: If no one was killed after Aurora dashes in, look for a chance to close in and lock her down with Riven W Ki Burst. If Aurora gets a takedown, her dash cooldown resets, so don’t leave low-health allies behind when retreating.
Aurora.build: If Aurora P Spirit Abjuration’s healing makes it hard to finish her even with a combo, buy Executioner’s Calling early. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Aurora’s damage. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about building a lot of health alone.
Aurora.combo: If you’re going for a kill, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile during the knock-up, then finish with Wind Slash once the amount of health lost has increased. Make sure to weave in basic attacks between spells.
Aurora.escape: After both Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are down, look for an opening to engage with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. Once you’re in close, stun her with Riven W Ki Burst.
Aurora.laning: Don’t use all of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; save at least one cast to respond to a counterattack. If Aurora Q Twofold Hex curses you and your health drops below half, retreat with the recall damage in mind.
Aurora.phase: Riven is strongest in the mid game as ability haste and attack damage stack up, so fight when Aurora’s mobility spells are down. In the late game, choose your engage carefully because it’s hard to break through a tougher front line on your own.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and becomes more dangerous as the amount of health lost increases. If you’re cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora; if your health is low, retreat before the curse is recalled. After Aurora R Between Worlds appears, you’re slowed when leaving it, so get out before it activates or look for an opening to fight inside.

Akali.combo: Activate Riven R Blade of the Exile during the airborne window, then finish with Wind Slash after wearing down the enemy’s health. The key is not to miss basic attacks while chaining your spells.
Akali.escape: If only Akali W Twilight Shroud is down, she can still escape with Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution, so don’t rush your engage. If Akali E Shuriken Flip misses and Akali R Perfect Execution is still on cooldown, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. Once you’re close, stun her with Riven W Ki Burst to prevent her escape.
Akali.build: Akali has relatively low armor, so Riven’s physical damage is effective against her. Building attack damage first also strengthens Riven E Valor’s shield. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Akali’s damage, and get health to account for the execute damage from Akali R Perfect Execution.
Akali.fight: Close in with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor, then stun Akali with Riven W Ki Burst and weave in basic attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade between spells. Instead of blindly following Akali into Akali W Twilight Shroud, hit her with Riven Q Broken Wings during the brief moment she reveals herself.
Akali.laning: Don’t use all of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; save one cast for a counterattack.
Akali.phase: Riven is strongest in the mid game as ability haste and attack damage stack up. In the late game, choose your engage carefully.
Akali.teamfight: Before engaging, make sure you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to escape with, and be ready for Akali to engage with Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Akali.watch: If you’re marked, her second dash will follow you even if you try to escape. If you get hit, don’t use Riven E Valor to disengage blindly; prepare for the follow-up attack.

Mordekaiser.laning: Spread out from your allies in front of Mordekaiser so several of you aren’t pulled by Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp.
Mordekaiser.build: If healing from Mordekaiser W Indestructible prevents you from finishing him, buy Executioner's Calling early. Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, Q Obliterate, and E Death's Grasp, and consider armor against his basic attacks as well. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise deals damage based on max health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Mordekaiser.combo: When looking for a kill, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile during the airborne window, and use Wind Slash, whose damage scales with missing health, to finish.
Mordekaiser.escape: Mordekaiser has no mobility ability, so when Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down, you have an opportunity to engage with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor.
Mordekaiser.fight: Look for short trades that last only one or two hits before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates, then back off. If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor, then stun him with Riven W Ki Burst at point-blank range. Right after Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield activates, don’t unload your damage; focus him once the shield has worn down or converted to healing.
Mordekaiser.phase: Look actively for opportunities in the mid game as ability haste and attack damage stack, but late game, choose your engage angle instead of trying to break through a frontline with increased health and armor alone.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so several of you aren’t pulled by Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, and don’t enter Mordekaiser R Realm of Death’s range alone while it’s ready. If there’s no good angle to engage, don’t force it; push the side lane.
Mordekaiser.watch: If you’re pulled by Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, you may be hit by Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise may activate, so dodge while managing your distance from the front. Once Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise is active, staying close works against you; back off with Riven E Valor or Riven Q Broken Wings. If Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don’t enter its range alone and risk a duel without help from your allies.

Kennen.watch: Dodge Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions. If two stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm build up, back off to prevent a third. Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom can lead to an area stun, so don’t stand clumped with allies when Kennen engages.
Kennen.build: Get movement speed first so you can escape telegraphed ranges. Build magic resistance rather than armor against the damage from Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, Kennen W Electrical Surge, and Kennen E Lightning Rush.
Kennen.combo: While the third cast of Riven Q Broken Wings knocks the opponent up, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile, then finish with Wind Slash, whose damage scales with missing health.
Kennen.escape: Engage after Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stacks have expired. If you used Riven E Valor to engage, check that the third cast of Riven Q Broken Wings will be available to disengage.
Kennen.fight: After Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. Once in melee range, stun him with Riven W Ki Burst and weave Riven P Runic Blade’s empowered basic attacks between casts of Riven Q Broken Wings.
Kennen.laning: Block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions, and step forward only briefly to last-hit. If two stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm build up, back off and wait for them to expire. Don’t use every cast of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; leave yourself room to retaliate.
Kennen.phase: Riven is strongest in the mid game. Late game, pick your fights instead of forcing frontal engages.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom doesn’t catch several of you, and use vision to block Kennen’s engage route. Before engaging, check that you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to disengage.

Olaf.phase: Riven is strongest in the mid game. Olaf’s relative strength falls off late, but choose your angle so you don’t recklessly engage into a tougher frontline.
Olaf.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. While Olaf Q Undertow is reducing your armor, that armor is less effective, and resistances can't reduce the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing, so also get health.
Olaf.combo: Weave in basic attacks reliably, and after using Riven R Blade of the Exile to increase your attack damage, use Wind Slash in the finishing stretch after Olaf has lost health.
Olaf.escape: Engage when Olaf Q Undertow misses and it’s hard for him to retrieve the axe, or right after Olaf R Ragnarok ends. Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, so you can close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor.
Olaf.fight: Weave empowered basic attacks between casts of Riven Q Broken Wings for a short trade, and use Riven W Ki Burst once you’re in melee range. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t keep fighting while using crowd control; create distance with Riven E Valor and Riven Q Broken Wings. After his ultimate ends, take advantage of Olaf having no ability to create distance on his own and engage again.
Olaf.laning: Move opposite the direction Olaf Q Undertow lands to make it harder for him to retrieve the axe and approach. Avoid forced trades early, and don’t use every cast of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions so you can respond to a counterattack. Look to trade once you have Riven Q Broken Wings, Riven W Ki Burst, and Riven E Valor.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows, so move away from where the axe lands. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so when your health is low, respond with Riven E Valor’s shield or by moving. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, Riven W Ki Burst’s stun and Riven Q Broken Wings’ knock-up won’t work; create distance and apply crowd control after it ends.

Fiora.watch: While Fiora W Riposte is available, don’t use both of your abilities carelessly. Bait it out, then move sideways to dodge the riposte. Fiora P Duelist's Dance can let her approach toward the vital’s direction, so stand on the opposite side and narrow the angle.
Fiora.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. If fights drag on or it’s hard to finish her with a combo because of the healing from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge, buy Executioner’s Calling early. Armor doesn’t work against true damage, and Fiora R Grand Challenge scales with your maximum health, so be wary of building a lot of health alone.
Fiora.combo: After Fiora has lost more health, finish with Wind Slash from Riven R Blade of the Exile. Focus on landing your basic attacks and don’t press Riven Q Broken Wings repeatedly.
Fiora.escape: Right after Fiora uses Fiora Q Lunge is your chance to engage with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, get close and use Riven W Ki Burst to cut off her escape.
Fiora.fight: Right after you bait out Fiora Q Lunge, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor. Once you confirm Fiora W Riposte is down, stay close, stun her with Riven W Ki Burst, and make a short trade by weaving in empowered basic attacks between spells. Don’t chase recklessly after the trade.
Fiora.laning: Stand opposite the side where the vital appears, then counterattack when Fiora dives in toward that direction. Don’t use all of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; save one cast for a counterattack.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stand against a wall to block access to a vital on one side.

Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee trade, so don’t force an engage. When clearing minions, save at least one Riven Q Broken Wings to respond to a counterattack.
Jax.build: Riven E Valor's shield scales with bonus attack damage, so build attack damage first. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so do not focus on only one type of resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your max health, so avoid relying on a large health stack alone.
Jax.combo: When going for a kill, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while your opponent is airborne, then use Wind Slash at the end, once more health has been lost.
Jax.escape: The window for Riven to engage is right after Jax Q Leap Strike and Jax E Counter Strike have both been spent. If Jax E Counter Strike is active or you need to avoid its recast stun, save Riven E Valor or Riven Q Broken Wings to disengage.
Jax.fight: Trade after Jax E Counter Strike ends, alternating Riven Q Broken Wings and basic attacks. If Jax Q Leap Strike is also down, close the gap with Riven E Valor or Riven Q Broken Wings and stun him with Riven W Ki Burst.
Jax.phase: Riven is strong in the mid game, when her ability haste and attack damage have built up. In the late game, choose your engage carefully instead of trying to break through the frontline alone.
Jax.teamfight: Do not group near Jax while Jax E Counter Strike is active; wait for the area stun to end. Before engaging, check that you can save Riven Q Broken Wings to disengage.
Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, basic attacks are dodged, and its recast damage increases with each attack dodged. Save Riven E Valor or Riven Q Broken Wings to get out of Jax E Counter Strike's stun range.

Kayle.build: If Kayle can withstand your combo with the healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing, work Executioner's Calling into your build early. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Kayle’s main damage. However, Kayle Q Radiant Blast reduces your magic resistance, so dodging the direct hit comes first.
Kayle.combo: If Kayle R Divine Judgment’s invulnerability is down, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while Kayle is airborne, and use Wind Slash at the end, after her health has been reduced. Instead of chaining Riven Q Broken Wings back to back, make sure to land basic attacks between casts.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no innate dash, but she can escape by slowing you with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and boosting her movement speed with Kayle W Celestial Blessing. If you dodged Kayle Q Radiant Blast or she has used Kayle W Celestial Blessing, close the gap with Riven E Valor and Riven Q Broken Wings, then land Riven W Ki Burst at close range.
Kayle.fight: Close in with Riven E Valor or Riven Q Broken Wings, lock Kayle down with Riven W Ki Burst, and weave in empowered basic attacks from Riven P Runic Blade between abilities. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is still available, hold your attacks during the invulnerability and finish her after it ends.
Kayle.teamfight: Look for a path to reach Kayle from the flank or outside vision instead of hitting the frontline head-on. Before engaging, check that you’ll have Riven Q Broken Wings available to disengage. If there’s no angle to reach her, push a side lane.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and reduces your armor and magic resistance, so dodge the direct hit before engaging. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade gets stronger based on your missing health, so be careful when your health is low. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t unload your damage. Lock her down with Riven W Ki Burst or the knock-up from Riven Q Broken Wings to wait out the invulnerability.
Kayle.laning: Don’t use every cast of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; save one to respond to a counterattack.
Kayle.phase: The mid game is when Riven is strong with stacked attack damage and ability haste, so pressure objectives and towers.

Quinn.teamfight: Start team fights instead of facing Quinn alone in a side lane. Look for an engage angle as Riven from outside vision or from the flank, and don’t force it if you can’t get close.
Quinn.build: Build armor first. Quinn's main damage is physical, so build armor rather than magic resistance.
Quinn.escape: The moment Quinn E Vault is down is your window to engage. Until then, Quinn can push back your approach, so wait; once E is down, follow up with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor.
Quinn.fight: Right after Quinn E Vault is down, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. Once close, stun her with Riven W Ki Burst and weave in empowered basic attacks between abilities.
Quinn.laning: Farm when Quinn P Harrier's mark isn't on you, and stand behind minions so it's easier to block Quinn Q Blinding Assault. Don't use every Riven Q Broken Wings cast to clear minions.
Quinn.watch: When marked by Quinn P Harrier, move outside Quinn's basic attack range to avoid her empowered attack. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind minions, and don't force an approach while Quinn E Vault is available.

Volibear.build: If Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing makes it hard to finish him, work Executioner's Calling into your build early. Build armor first to account for the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer.
Volibear.escape: After you avoid Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s engage and stun, look to close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor. If Volibear can still use R Stormbringer, don’t chase just because one Q is down; look for an opening before his R comes back up. Once you’re close, stun him with Riven W Ki Burst to make it harder for him to escape.
Volibear.fight: Dodge the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter to deny him the shield, then take a short trade. Weave empowered basic attacks between casts of Riven Q Broken Wings, and only commit deeply when you can finish the fight before Volibear W Frenzied Maul has a chance to heal him. If Volibear approaches while building passive stacks, delay the fight and engage after the stacks fall off.
Volibear.laning: If Volibear has activated Q Thundering Smash, use a mobility ability to stay out of basic attack range instead of running straight away.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear has built passive stacks by hitting minions or monsters, don’t fight him in that state; wait for the stacks to fall off. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t stay under your turret at low health; retreat deeper into your side of the map, and use a mobility ability to leave his landing spot.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash increases his movement speed and stuns with an empowered basic attack, so when you see him activate it, use Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor to stay out of basic attack range. If you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, move sideways to avoid the damage and slow, and watch where Volibear is trying to get his shield. Volibear W Frenzied Maul heals and empowers follow-up attacks, so don’t extend a fight just because health has been lost.
Volibear.combo: Activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while the enemy is airborne, then finish with the recast attack that grows stronger in proportion to missing health. If you used E to engage, first check whether you’ll have Q left to disengage.
Volibear.phase: In the late game, it’s difficult to break through a tanky frontline alone, so choose your entry angle carefully.

Aatrox.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If Aatrox’s healing makes it hard to finish him, buy Executioner’s Calling early. Add penetration when high armor blocks Riven’s physical damage.
Aatrox.combo: Don’t force an animation cancel if you can’t reliably land the basic attack.
Aatrox.escape: Right after you bait out Aatrox E Umbral Dash is your chance to engage with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you or you need to dodge the knock-up from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, use a mobility spell to escape first, then engage.
Aatrox.fight: Trade right after Aatrox uses his empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion or uses Aatrox E Umbral Dash. Close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor, then stay close and stun him with Riven W Ki Burst. Weave basic attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade between casts of Riven Q Broken Wings.
Aatrox.laning: Don’t use all of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; save at least one cast to respond to Aatrox’s counterattack.
Aatrox.phase: In the late game, it’s hard to break through a front line with more health and armor on your own, so choose your engage carefully.
Aatrox.teamfight: Before engaging, make sure you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to escape with. If there’s no opening to approach, push the side lane.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals his main damage and knocks you up, so when you see the cast animation, move outside the blade’s edge or move in close inside it. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave its area immediately; save Riven E Valor or Riven Q Broken Wings for this. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, his healing increases, so create distance and wait out its duration.

Chogath.build: If Cho’Gath P Carnivore’s healing makes it hard to finish him with a combo, buy Executioner’s Calling early. Build magic resistance against the damage from Cho’Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. Resistance can’t reduce the true damage from Cho’Gath R Feast, and focusing solely on greatly increasing health also increases the damage from Cho’Gath E Vorpal Spikes, which scales with your maximum health.
Chogath.combo: If you’re going for a kill, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while the enemy is airborne, then finish with Wind Slash once the amount of health lost has increased.
Chogath.escape: Right after Cho’Gath uses Cho’Gath Q Rupture on the wave or misses it is your chance to engage with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor. If you’re hit by the silence from Cho’Gath W Feral Scream, you can’t escape with a mobility spell, so engage from outside its frontal area. If you used Riven E Valor to engage, consider whether to save the third cast of Riven Q Broken Wings for your escape.
Chogath.fight: When Cho’Gath Q Rupture’s warning appears, dodge sideways with Riven E Valor or Q Broken Wings, then approach. Avoid the frontal area of Cho’Gath W Feral Scream, get close, and stun him with Riven W Ki Burst. During trades, weave basic attacks between casts of Riven Q Broken Wings to make use of the empowerment from Riven P Runic Blade.
Chogath.laning: Move out of the line where Cho’Gath E Vorpal Spikes can hit you along with minions. When pushing the wave, don’t use all of Riven Q Broken Wings; save a cast to respond to a counterattack.
Chogath.phase: Cho’Gath gets stronger as he builds stacks, so in the late game choose your engage carefully instead of trying to break through the front line alone.
Chogath.teamfight: Instead of fighting for a long time in front of Cho’Gath, who can hold his ground, approach the back line from the flank or out of vision with Riven E Valor and the third cast of Q Broken Wings. If there’s no opening to engage, don’t force it; push the side lane.
Chogath.watch: Cho’Gath Q Rupture knocks you up after a warning appears beneath you, so move sideways when you see the marker and dodge with Riven E Valor if needed. If Cho’Gath W Feral Scream silences you, you can’t use Riven’s mobility spells, so approach from outside its frontal area. If your health is at or below half, move out of range of the true damage from Cho’Gath R Feast.

Darius.build: Buy Executioner’s Calling early to counter the healing from Darius Q Decimate. Build armor first against Darius P Hemorrhage, Darius Q Decimate, and Darius W Crippling Strike, but keep in mind that armor alone can’t stop the penetration from Darius E Apprehend or the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Darius has relatively high armor, so add penetration to deal with it when building for Riven’s physical damage.
Darius.combo: Weave in basic attacks to make use of the empowered attacks from Riven P Runic Blade.
Darius.escape: When Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown, look for an opening to engage. You can also close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor while Darius R Noxian Guillotine is down, then stun him with Riven W Ki Burst once you’re close.
Darius.fight: Trade briefly when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown, then disengage with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. You can also harass right after he uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions. Avoid long fights that let Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up; create distance until the stacks wear off, then go in again.
Darius.laning: Don’t use all of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; save at least one cast to respond to a counterattack.
Darius.phase: Riven is strongest in the mid game as attack damage and ability haste stack up. In the late game, choose your engage instead of trying to break through a front line with more health and armor on your own.
Darius.teamfight: If you stay in a fight too long with Darius P Hemorrhage stacks on you, Darius can chain a kill into a reset with Darius R Noxian Guillotine, so fully disengage when your health gets low. Look for a flank or an approach to the back line from out of vision, and make sure you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to escape with before going in.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow up with basic attacks, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so wait out of range and save Riven E Valor to respond. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade’s edge or hug him to reduce its damage and healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance. If your health is low while the stacks are on you, get completely out of range of the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If fights drag on because Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases, Q Infected Bonesaw, and W Heart Zapper heal him, buy Executioner’s Calling early.
DrMundo.combo: Follow up with basic attacks and the third cast of Q Broken Wings to knock the opponent up. If you’re going for a kill, use Wind Slash from Riven R Blade of the Exile after the opponent’s health has decreased. Don’t skip basic attacks and cast Q repeatedly.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no spell that creates distance on its own, so dodge Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, trigger his passive, then look for a chance to engage with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor. Use Riven W Ki Burst once you’re close. If you used Riven E Valor to engage, first calculate whether the third cast of Q Broken Wings will remain available for your escape.
DrMundo.fight: Close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor, but if Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, use Riven W Ki Burst to trigger it first, then knock him up with the third cast of Q Broken Wings. Weave in basic attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade between spells, and don’t fixate on finishing Dr. Mundo when Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active.
DrMundo.laning: Keep minions between you and Dr. Mundo to avoid Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. After a trade, if you can step on the canister Dr. Mundo drops, do so to deny his healing and passive cooldown reduction. When pushing the wave, don’t use all of Riven Q Broken Wings; save one cast to respond to a counterattack.
DrMundo.phase: Riven is strong in the mid game as ability haste and attack damage stack up. In the late game, it’s hard to break through a front line with more health and armor on your own, so look for advantages elsewhere instead of fighting Dr. Mundo for a long time while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is available.
DrMundo.teamfight: Instead of fighting front liners like Dr. Mundo head-on for a long time, approach the back line from the flank or out of vision with Riven E Valor and the third cast of Q Broken Wings. Before engaging, make sure you have a cast of Q Broken Wings left to escape with. If several enemies are grouped nearby, use the area effects on the third cast of Q Broken Wings and W Ki Burst. If there’s no opening to approach, don’t force it; push the side lane.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits the first target it reaches, deals damage based on current health, and slows. When your health is high, avoid it by keeping minions between you and Dr. Mundo. If it looks like it will hit as you approach, use the shield from Riven E Valor. Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so don’t count on the third hit of Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven W Ki Burst to immobilize him while his passive is available.

Gangplank.build: If Gangplank Q Parrrley poke hurts, build armor from the laning phase to mitigate the physical damage from Q and Gangplank E Powder Keg. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy's healing makes it hard to finish him, fit Executioner's Calling into your build early. The true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage cannot be mitigated by resistances, and armor does not mitigate the magic damage from Gangplank R Cannon Barrage either.
Gangplank.combo: While your opponent is airborne, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile, then finish with the recast, Wind Slash, once they have lost more health. Do not press Riven Q Broken Wings in quick succession; weave in basic attacks.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage when Gangplank E Powder Keg has just been placed and Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down.
Gangplank.fight: Engage with Riven E Valor or Riven Q Broken Wings just after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, before it is primed. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, stay close, stun him with Riven W Ki Burst, and weave in empowered attacks from Riven P Runic Blade between abilities. Delay the fight if a primed keg is nearby.
Gangplank.laning: Take advantage of the moment Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, and back away from primed kegs. When clearing minions, save a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings so you can respond if he fights back.
Gangplank.phase: Riven is strongest in the mid game, when she has built ability haste and attack damage, so look for fights when Gangplank E Powder Keg has just been placed. In the late game, choose your engage carefully instead of trying to break through the frontline alone.
Gangplank.teamfight: Avoid spots with primed or overlapping Gangplank E Powder Kegs, and check whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage has been used before choosing when to fight over objectives. If there is no engage angle, do not force a fight; push a side lane instead.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg slows when it explodes, so fight near freshly placed kegs and back away from primed or overlapping ones. You can destroy a keg yourself from outside its blast radius. Gangplank W Remove Scurvy removes crowd control and heals, so check whether it has been used before trying to finish with Riven W Ki Burst and the knockup from Riven Q Broken Wings.

Garen.build: If Garen P Perseverance's healing makes it hard to finish him, fit Executioner's Calling into your build early. Build armor first against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and E Judgment. However, Garen E Judgment reduces your armor and R Demacian Justice deals true damage, so do not rely on armor alone and remain within the spin's range or Garen's execution threshold.
Garen.combo: While your opponent is airborne, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile, and use Wind Slash to finish after Garen has lost health. If Garen E Judgment hits you for too long during your combo, disengage instead of staying until the end.
Garen.escape: The window to engage with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor is right after Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack is used. Garen has no ability to create distance, so stun him with Riven W Ki Burst once you are close, but delay the stun right after Garen W Courage activates.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly just after Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack is used. Engage with Riven Q Broken Wings, weaving in basic attacks to use Runic Blade's empowered attacks, then use Riven E Valor's shield and movement to disengage when Garen E Judgment spins. If Garen W Courage has just activated, briefly delay Riven W Ki Burst and the knockup from Riven Q Broken Wings.
Garen.laning: You become less favored as Garen W Courage's growth stacks build, so push the lane or apply pressure from the early game. Do not use all casts of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; save one to respond if he fights back.
Garen.phase: Riven is strongest in the mid game, when she has built ability haste and attack damage. You become less favored as Garen W Courage's growth stacks build and the game goes late, so slow his growth with early pressure and choose your engages carefully in the late game.
Garen.teamfight: Before engaging, check that you can save a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings to disengage. If there is no angle to approach, push a side lane.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack silences you and prevents you from fighting back, so do not engage first while it is active. When Garen E Judgment starts spinning, use Riven E Valor to create distance and avoid taking hits for long. Garen W Courage grants a shield and tenacity right after activation, so delay Riven W Ki Burst and the knockup from Riven Q Broken Wings by half a beat. If you are below half health, stay out of Garen R Demacian Justice's range, as it deals true damage based on your missing health.

Gnar.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, E Hop / Crunch, and R GNAR!. Armor does not mitigate the magic damage or percent max health damage from Gnar W Hyper / Wallop, so be cautious about relying on a large health stack alone. If you have no mobility ability to respond to Mega Gnar's wall stun, consider tenacity first.
Gnar.escape: The window to close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor is right after you bait out Gnar E Hop / Crunch. Check that Mega Gnar's Gnar R GNAR! is down or that he does not have an angle to stun you against a wall before engaging.
Gnar.fight: Engage with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor just after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is used, then stun him with Riven W Ki Burst once you are close. Weave in attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade between abilities to deal damage. Avoid a direct fight just after he transforms into Mega Gnar, and look for an all-in just after he returns to Mini Gnar, while he cannot transform again.
Gnar.laning: Step out of Mini Gnar's Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss path to prevent him from catching the returning boomerang; this creates a window before his next poke.
Gnar.phase: In the late game, it is hard to break through a tankier frontline alone, so choose your engage carefully and take advantage of Gnar's weak window just after he returns from Mega Gnar to Mini Gnar.
Gnar.teamfight: Avoid fighting with your back to a wall or in narrow terrain so Mega Gnar's Gnar R GNAR! cannot knock you into a wall. When Gnar returns to Mini Gnar and cannot transform again yet, look for a chance to start a team fight with your allies.
Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss slows you. Mini Gnar's boomerang can hit you again on its return, so step out of its path. Gnar E Hop / Crunch can create distance, and Mega Gnar's Gnar R GNAR! stuns enemies knocked into a wall, so do not fight with your back to one.

Gwen.build: Buy Executioner's Calling early to counter the healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts. Consider magic resistance items such as Spectre's Cowl first against Gwen's primary damage, and get some armor to deal with her basic attack damage. Gwen W Hallowed Mist increases her armor, so consider armor penetration if Riven's physical damage is not getting through.
Gwen.combo: Make sure to weave in basic attacks between abilities to use Riven P Runic Blade's empowered attacks. When going for a kill, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while your opponent is airborne, then finish with Wind Slash once more health has been lost.
Gwen.escape: The window to close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor is right after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is used. Once you are close, stun her with Riven W Ki Burst to make it hard for her to escape.
Gwen.fight: Trade before Gwen Q Snip Snip!'s stacks build up or just after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is used. Engage with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor, stun her with Riven W Ki Burst, and weave in empowered attacks between abilities. If you end up in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, use Riven E Valor to move sideways out of it.
Gwen.laning: Stay outside Gwen's basic attack range to stop the healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash comes back faster when there are many minions nearby, so create an opportunity to fight outside the wave. When pushing the lane, do not use all casts of Riven Q Broken Wings; save one to respond if she fights back.
Gwen.phase: In the late game, it is hard to break through a frontline with more health and armor alone, so choose your engage carefully.
Gwen.teamfight: Avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and before engaging, check that you can save Riven Q Broken Wings to disengage. If there is no engage angle, push a side lane.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!'s cone deals true damage, so move sideways or use Riven E Valor to get out of the center. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you cannot target Gwen from outside the mist, so enter it or wait until it ends. Watch out for healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and percent max health damage from Gwen R Needlework.

Illaoi.build: Illaoi can sustain through fights with Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, so buy Executioner's Calling early. Build armor first against the physical damage from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Q Tentacle Smash, and W Harsh Lesson. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals percent max health damage, so avoid relying on a large health stack alone.
Illaoi.escape: The opportunity to engage comes right after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is used. If you have dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit, you can reduce the risk of being caught and approach with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor.
Illaoi.fight: Close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor right after you bait out Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, then get close and stun her with Riven W Ki Burst. In trades, weave basic attacks between casts of Riven Q Broken Wings to use Riven P Runic Blade's empowered attacks. If Illaoi R Leap of Faith activates, create distance until its damage window ends.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave away from walls and last-hit from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit's range. Do not use all casts of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; leave casts available to respond if she fights back. If you can fight after your spirit is pulled out, fight back; when you do not fight, break the tether and then dodge the first tentacle.
Illaoi.phase: Riven grows strong in the mid game as her ability haste and attack damage build, but in the late game it is hard to break through a frontline with more health and armor alone, so choose your engage carefully.
Illaoi.teamfight: Destroy Illaoi's tentacles if you can; otherwise, move the fight away from walls. Do not group up against Illaoi R Leap of Faith; spread out and wait out its duration. Riven should look for an angle to engage the backline from the flank or outside vision, and before engaging, check that you can save Riven Q Broken Wings to disengage.
Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit pulls out your spirit and leaves a slow and mark, so last-hit from outside its range in lane and dodge it when she uses it. Illaoi R Leap of Faith deals heavy area damage in a short time, so when it activates, do not fight near her tentacles; create distance instead.

Irelia.build: Buy Executioner's Calling early to counter healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge. Riven deals her damage in a short burst, so reducing Irelia's healing makes it easier to finish her after your combo.
Irelia.combo: While Irelia is airborne, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile, then finish with Wind Slash once more health has been lost.
Irelia.escape: The opportunity to engage comes right after you bait out Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Irelia E Flawless Duet's stun is also down, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor, then pin her down with Riven W Ki Burst.
Irelia.fight: Close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor just after Irelia Q Bladesurge is used. Once you are close, stun her with Riven W Ki Burst and weave in attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade between abilities.
Irelia.laning: Do not leave a low health minion between you and Irelia, and step back when a minion is about to die. Do not use all casts of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; keep casts available to respond if she fights back.
Irelia.phase: In the late game, it is hard to break through a tankier frontline alone, so choose your engage carefully.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet can turn a team fight, so target Irelia first. Before engaging, check whether you can save Riven Q Broken Wings to get out.
Irelia.watch: Irelia approaches by using Irelia Q Bladesurge on low health minions, so create distance when a minion is about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and do not rush to finish her while she is sustaining through Irelia W Defiant Dance. If you are trapped by Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first, and get enough movement speed to leave telegraphed attack ranges. Magic resistance cannot block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate deal damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Jayce.combo: When looking for a kill, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while the enemy is airborne, then finish with Wind Slash after their health has dropped. Land each basic attack deliberately instead of rushing and skipping them.
Jayce.escape: The moment after you force Jayce to use Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is your window to engage with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. If Jayce E Thundering Blow’s knockback is down too, close in and lock him down with Riven W Ki Burst. If you used Riven E Valor to engage, check that you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to disengage.
Jayce.fight: Right after Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is down, close the gap with Riven E Valor and Riven Q Broken Wings. Once you’re in melee range, stun him with Riven W Ki Burst and weave an empowered basic attack between casts of Riven Q Broken Wings. If Jayce E Thundering Blow’s knockback is still available, carefully judge your engage distance.
Jayce.laning: Jayce’s poke is strong early, so farm while moving side to side, and don’t stubbornly stay in lane if you’ve lost a lot of health. Don’t use every cast of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; save one to retaliate.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so farm defensively and wait until Riven has her abilities. In the mid game, make use of the power Riven gains from attack damage and ability haste; late game, avoid reckless frontal engages.
Jayce.teamfight: Watch for Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap to go down, then approach from the flank or out of vision. Before going in, check that you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to disengage. If there’s no good angle to get on him, push the side lane.
Jayce.watch: When Jayce is holding his cannon, anticipate Jayce Q Shock Blast when he places Jayce E Acceleration Gate, and sidestep out of its line. When he has his hammer, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.

Kled.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, Kled W Violent Tendencies, and Kled E Jousting. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and Kled W Violent Tendencies and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone. If Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth attack is a problem, consider an effect that reduces attack speed.
Kled.combo: If you use Riven E Valor to approach, first check that you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to disengage. Weave in basic attacks to make use of Runic Blade’s damage, and use Wind Slash from Riven R Blade of the Exile to finish when Kled has lost more health.
Kled.escape: If only Kled E Jousting is down, check whether Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is still available before engaging. If both movement abilities are down, or before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor and prevent his escape with Riven W Ki Burst. If you’re caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, the window to escape is before it pulls you; use a saved mobility ability then.
Kled.fight: When Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, create distance first to avoid his fourth attack, then re-engage. While Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are down, approach with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor and lock him down with Riven W Ki Burst.
Kled.laning: Don’t use every cast of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; save at least one to respond to Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope or a dash. Kled can build courage and remount after dismounting Skaarl, so if you can’t finish him for sure, create distance and pressure him to keep him from farming in lane.
Kled.phase: Riven is strongest in the mid game as her attack damage and ability haste stack, so look for openings when Kled’s movement abilities are down. Kled falls off late, but Riven also has trouble breaking through a frontline with increased health and armor alone, so choose your engage angle.
Kled.teamfight: Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can come from out of vision, so keep flank vision. If you can’t stop the engage, remember that Kled charges the first allied champion in his path; don’t disrupt your formation.
Kled.watch: If you’re caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, create distance with Riven E Valor or Riven Q Broken Wings before the pull triggers. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, back off and re-engage so you don’t take the max-health-based damage from his fourth attack. Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are both ways for him to dash, so don’t chase just because one is down.

KSante.build: K'Sante's high armor mitigates Riven's physical damage, so include penetration in your damage build. Prioritize armor over magic resistance to mitigate K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct, Q Ntofo Strikes, and W Path Maker. K'Sante W Path Maker's true damage cannot be reduced by resistances, so use health to withstand it.
KSante.combo: While your opponent is airborne, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile, then finish with Wind Slash once more health has been lost. Do not press Riven Q Broken Wings in quick succession so you can reliably fit in basic attacks.
KSante.escape: If only one of K'Sante W Path Maker and E Footwork is down, he still has the other mobility ability, so do not rush your engage. If several mobility abilities and crowd control are down, especially before K'Sante R All Out is back, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor, then catch him with Riven W Ki Burst.
KSante.fight: Save your damage and stun while K'Sante charges W Path Maker, sidestep, then fight. When K'Sante R All Out activates, unload your damage during the window when his health and resistances are lower, but do not face his increased damage and lifesteal alone for too long. Weave empowered attacks between casts of Riven Q Broken Wings to secure your damage.
KSante.laning: When clearing minions, do not use all casts of Riven Q Broken Wings and lose your means of fighting back.
KSante.phase: In the late game, it is hard to break through a tankier frontline alone, so choose your engage instead of fighting K'Sante head-on for too long.
KSante.teamfight: When you see K'Sante charging W Path Maker, save your stun and damage and dodge his charge path; do not fight K'Sante alone for long while R All Out is active. If a long fight is expected, make sure at least one member of your team has a source of Grievous Wounds. If there is no engage angle, push a side lane.
KSante.watch: If you are hit by K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes repeatedly or K'Sante builds stacks by hitting minions, move out of range to avoid his next pull and stun. While K'Sante charges W Path Maker, he is unstoppable and takes reduced damage, so do not use Riven W Ki Burst; use Riven E Valor to dodge sideways from his charge path. Do not have terrain behind you when facing him, so K'Sante R All Out cannot knock you over a wall.

Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force, which are his main sources of damage. Malphite’s high armor blocks Riven’s physical damage, so you can include armor penetration, but don’t rely on stacking armor penetration to break through him head-on.
Malphite.combo: While the opponent is airborne, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile, then finish with Wind Slash, which grows stronger as missing health increases. Land your basic attacks between casts instead of pressing Riven Q Broken Wings back to back.
Malphite.escape: Once you’re in melee range, stun him with Riven W Ki Burst so he can’t escape. Don’t engage right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then trade when Malphite Q Seismic Shard and E Ground Slam are down. Weave Riven P Runic Blade-empowered basic attacks between casts of Riven Q Broken Wings, and use Riven W Ki Burst once you’re in melee range. If you used Riven E Valor to engage, also check that you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to get out.
Malphite.laning: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, but don’t stay within range of Malphite Q Seismic Shard for long. Don’t use every cast of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions and leave yourself with no way to retaliate.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn’t knock several of you up, then retaliate as soon as R is down. Before engaging, check that you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to disengage. If there’s no good angle, push the side lane.
Malphite.watch: If you’re hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard, its slow makes it hard to engage or retreat, so don’t start a trade immediately afterward. Malphite E Ground Slam reduces attack speed and weakens the damage of Riven P Runic Blade-empowered basic attacks, so engage after E is down. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t be interrupted by Riven W Ki Burst, so don’t give him an engage angle when you can’t see his position.

Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, his main source of damage. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire and R Fury of the Sands, so leave the area effect and avoid fighting while his ultimate is active.
Nasus.combo: While the enemy is airborne, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile, then finish with Wind Slash when the amount of missing health has increased. Landing basic attacks is important; don’t force them if Nasus W Wither makes it difficult to keep attacking.
Nasus.escape: Once Nasus W Wither is down, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor, then use Riven W Ki Burst at point-blank range.
Nasus.fight: Weave Riven P Runic Blade-empowered basic attacks between casts of Riven Q Broken Wings, then stun him with Riven W Ki Burst once you’re in melee range. Don’t force an extended fight while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.laning: Pushing the wave under Nasus’s turret makes it easy for him to stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Let the wave come to your side, pressure Nasus when he goes for last hits, and call for a jungle gank. Don’t use every cast of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; keep a way to retaliate.
Nasus.phase: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks last permanently, putting you at a greater disadvantage as time goes on, so slow his growth from the early game.
Nasus.teamfight: Don’t fight Nasus head-on while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active; keep your distance. Before engaging, check that you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to disengage.
Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces movement speed and attack speed, making Riven’s basic-attack trades and disengages difficult. Armor is reduced while you’re on Nasus E Spirit Fire, so get out with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, create distance and wait it out unless you have a clear advantage.

Ornn.build: Get attack damage and ability haste first. Attack damage also strengthens Riven E Valor's shield. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while W Bellows Breath and R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so avoid investing in only one type of resistance. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Ornn.combo: If Ornn's mobility ability is down and you see a chance to kill him, close in with Riven E Valor, then stun him with Riven W Ki Burst woven between Riven Q Broken Wings casts and basic attacks.
Ornn.escape: Don't engage just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down. It's an especially good window to go in when Ornn R Call of the Forge God is also down and he hasn't used it again yet. Close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor, then lock him down with W Ki Burst. If the trade turns against you, escape with a saved Q Broken Wings cast; if you need to cross a wall, save the third cast.
Ornn.fight: Weave empowered basic attacks from Riven P Runic Blade between abilities, and use Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor to close in while Ornn E Searing Charge or R Call of the Forge God is down. Once close, stun him with Riven W Ki Burst, but if you used E Valor to engage, consider whether to save a Riven Q Broken Wings cast to disengage.
Ornn.laning: If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, stick to him and interrupt the craft. When clearing minions, don't use every Riven Q Broken Wings cast; save some to respond to a counterattack.
Ornn.phase: Late game, it's difficult for Riven to break through Ornn alone once he's stacked health and armor, so choose your engage carefully.
Ornn.teamfight: Move out of the straight line between Ornn and the spirit summoned by Ornn R Call of the Forge God, and dodge the return strike after the spirit passes. If there's no opening to approach, don't force a fight into Ornn's frontline; push a side lane instead.
Ornn.watch: Near the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and walls, watch out for the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge. When the pillar appears or Ornn prepares to charge, use Riven Q Broken Wings or E Valor to escape through the open side. If you become Brittle from the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, keep your distance until the effect ends.

Pantheon.build: Build armor first against Pantheon's main damage. However, account for the penetration from Pantheon R Grand Starfall instead of stacking only armor, and add penetration so Riven's physical damage isn't blocked by Pantheon's high armor. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Pantheon.combo: If you're going for a kill, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while the enemy is airborne, then finish with Wind Slash once they've lost a lot of health. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is facing you, wait for it to end or circle around to the side before dealing damage.
Pantheon.fight: If Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, close in with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor, then stun him with Riven W Ki Burst once you're close. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault comes out, stop attacking from the front and wait for it to end or move to the side.
Pantheon.laning: In the early game, avoid giving up a kill and buy time. Keep minions between you and Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If you use every Riven Q Broken Wings cast to clear minions, you'll be vulnerable to a counterattack, so save at least one cast. Weave basic attacks between abilities to use the empowered attacks from Riven P Runic Blade.
Pantheon.phase: Riven is strong in the mid game once she has attack damage and ability haste, while Pantheon's influence falls off late. Even then, Riven shouldn't blindly dive into a durable frontline.
Pantheon.teamfight: If Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks you from the front, wait for it to end or circle around to the side. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, move outside its landing area. If there's no opening to engage, don't force it; push a side lane instead.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted enemy within range, so don't give him that distance when he can use it. You can reduce the damage from Pantheon Q Comet Spear by keeping minions between you. Don't unload damage from the front into Pantheon E Aegis Assault; wait for it to end or circle around to the side.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so be wary of stacking health alone. You don't need to prioritize magic resistance for the magic damage from Poppy P Iron Ambassador and Poppy W Steadfast Presence.
Poppy.combo: When going for a kill, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while the enemy is airborne, then finish with Wind Slash after the amount of health lost has increased. If you use Riven E Valor before engaging, also account for how many Riven Q Broken Wings casts you'll have left to disengage.
Poppy.escape: Right after you bait out Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to go in with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don't dash; wait for it to end or walk in. If the fight turns against you and you need to escape over a wall, use Riven Q Broken Wings twice beforehand and save the third cast.
Poppy.fight: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. Once close, stun her with Riven W Ki Burst, and weave basic attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade between Riven Q Broken Wings casts. Even if Poppy's health has decreased, her armor can increase further, so calculate your finishing damage before going in.
Poppy.laning: Fight in open space instead of with your back to a wall or narrow passage to avoid the wall collision from Poppy E Heroic Charge. When the shield thrown by Poppy P Iron Ambassador lands, step on it first so she can't gain a shield. Don't use every Riven Q Broken Wings cast to clear minions; save some to respond to a counterattack.
Poppy.phase: Riven is strongest in the mid game as ability haste and attack damage stack up. Late game, choose your engage carefully instead of trying to break through a frontline with stacked health and armor on your own.
Poppy.teamfight: Look for an angle to reach the enemy backline from the side or out of vision instead of facing Poppy and the frontline head-on. Check whether Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, and calculate whether you'll have Riven Q Broken Wings left to disengage before engaging.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, dashing with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor will be blocked, and you won't be able to use mobility abilities for a short time. If you get hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the area before the second burst of damage. If you see Poppy charging R Keeper's Verdict, move sideways out of her path.

Renekton.build: If Renekton Q Cull the Meek's healing makes it hard to finish him, buy Executioner's Calling early. Build armor first against Renekton's main Q, W, and E damage, but position to dodge empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice's dash and avoid its armor reduction.
Renekton.combo: When you see a chance for a kill, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while the enemy is airborne, then finish with Wind Slash once a lot of health has been lost.
Renekton.escape: Right after Renekton uses E Slice and Dice to disengage is your window to engage. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator is also down, close in with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor, then use Riven W Ki Burst.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton's rage bar is empty or immediately after he's fully spent Q, W, and E. Weave empowered basic attacks between Riven Q Broken Wings casts, then stun him with Riven W Ki Burst once you're close. If Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor.
Renekton.laning: Don't stand inside or behind a minion wave where Renekton E Slice and Dice's first dash can hit your minions and enable a second dash. Even when pushing the wave, don't use every Riven Q Broken Wings cast; save one for a counterattack.
Renekton.phase: Riven gets strong in the mid game as ability haste and attack damage stack up, while Renekton's value falls from the mid game onward, so it's fine to avoid giving up kills and focus on scaling. Late game, Riven has trouble breaking through a durable frontline alone, so choose your engage carefully.
Renekton.teamfight: Before engaging, check whether you have a Q cast left to disengage. If there's no opening to get close, don't force it; push a side lane instead.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is around half full or higher, watch out for an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Empowered W breaks through Riven E Valor's shield first, so don't fight in range of an enraged Renekton expecting to survive with your shield.

Rumble.build: Get attack damage, since it also strengthens Riven E Valor's shield. If you need a defensive item, prioritize one with magic resistance. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Rumble.combo: Activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while the enemy is airborne, then finish with Wind Slash once a lot of health has been lost. Don't spam Riven Q Broken Wings and skip your basic attacks.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, so dodging Rumble E Electro Harpoon or waiting until he has used both shots creates an opening to engage. If he's also used Rumble W Scrap Shield, wait for the shield to disappear, then close in with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor.
Rumble.fight: If Rumble activates Rumble W Scrap Shield, hold your burst until the shield disappears. If you dodge Rumble E Electro Harpoon or he uses both shots, close in with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor for a short trade. Once close, stun him with Riven W Ki Burst and weave in basic attacks.
Rumble.laning: Don't stay within range of Rumble Q Flamespitter for long; make Rumble walk forward to reach you. When clearing minions, don't use every Riven Q Broken Wings cast; leave yourself room to respond to a counterattack.
Rumble.phase: Riven is strong in the mid game as attack damage and ability haste stack up, and should choose her engages carefully late game.
Rumble.teamfight: Look for an angle into the backline from the side or out of vision instead of fighting the frontline head-on for too long. Watch out for the slow from Rumble R The Equalizer and Rumble E Electro Harpoon, and check that you have Riven Q Broken Wings left to disengage before going in. If you can't get close, don't force it; wait for another opening or push a side lane.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on your maximum health while you're close to him, so after a trade, create distance with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor. If you get hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, use a mobility ability to move out of the way before the second shot arrives. If both shots hit, the slow becomes stronger and your magic resistance is reduced.

Sett.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. The true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker can't be reduced by resistance, and Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Sett.combo: Activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while Sett is airborne, then finish with Wind Slash when a lot of health has been lost. Sett W Haymaker can get stronger after your combo, so don't stay at the center of its aiming line.
Sett.fight: While Sett R The Show Stopper is down, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. Once close, stun him with Riven W Ki Burst, and weave basic attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade between Riven Q Broken Wings casts. Immediately after dealing heavy damage, watch out for Sett W Haymaker: back off briefly, then re-engage.
Sett.phase: Riven is strong in the mid game as ability haste and attack damage stack up. Late game, choose your engage carefully instead of trying to break through the frontline alone.
Sett.teamfight: While Sett R The Show Stopper is available, account for where he could grab and throw you. Position so that you don't give Sett E Facebreaker enemies on both sides. If there's no opening to engage, don't force it; push a side lane instead.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker gets stronger right after he takes a lot of damage, so after dealing damage, back away and wait for his Grit to cool off. Sett E Facebreaker stuns when there are enemies on both sides of Sett, so avoid positioning with Sett between you and the minion wave.
Sett.laning: Don't use every Riven Q Broken Wings cast to clear minions; save some to respond to a counterattack. To avoid the stun from Sett E Facebreaker, don't stand on the opposite side of Sett from the minion wave.

Shen.build: Riven E Valor's shield scales with bonus attack damage, so build attack damage first. Consider tenacity first against the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. If you build resistance, account for both the physical damage from Shen E Shadow Dash and the magic damage from Shen Q Twilight Assault. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Shen.combo: If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, don't use basic attacks during it. After it ends, weave basic attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade between abilities. If you need a finishing blow, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while the enemy is airborne, then use Wind Slash after health has decreased.
Shen.escape: Shen E Shadow Dash is his only mobility ability and his hard crowd control, so the moment it misses is your chance to engage.
Shen.fight: Right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor. Use Riven W Ki Burst once you're close, and if Shen W Spirit's Refuge appears, hold your basic attacks until it ends, then weave them between abilities. If you're going for a kill, use Riven R Blade of the Exile to increase attack damage and range, and save Wind Slash to finish after the enemy has lost health.
Shen.laning: Take lane control and keep Shen occupied with CS, but don't use every Riven Q Broken Wings cast while clearing minions.
Shen.phase: Riven is strongest once ability haste and attack damage stack up in the mid game, so take advantage of the window while Shen E Shadow Dash is down. Late game, it's difficult to break through a frontline with stacked health and armor alone, so choose your engage carefully.
Shen.teamfight: If you can't finish the fight before Shen arrives, don't force an engage; take advantage on the lane he left with Shen R Stand United.
Shen.watch: If you're taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you're likely to get hit by basic attacks empowered by Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash. Also move out of the path of Shen's spirit blade as it returns during Shen Q Twilight Assault. Basic attacks carrying Riven P Runic Blade are negated inside Shen W Spirit's Refuge, so hold your basic attacks briefly.

Singed.build: Building attack damage first strengthens Riven E Valor's shield and increases your damage output. Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling deal magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor. Move speed also helps you get out of poisoned areas.
Singed.combo: While the third cast of Riven Q Broken Wings knocks the enemy up, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile. Recast it for a finishing blow once a lot of health has been lost. You can't dash while on Singed W Mega Adhesive, so check your entry point first.
Singed.escape: Engage when Singed W Mega Adhesive has not been placed on the ground and Singed E Fling is down. Close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor, then catch him with Riven W Ki Burst. If you used Riven E Valor to engage, consider whether to save a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings for your escape.
Singed.fight: Engage with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor, land Riven W Ki Burst, and weave empowered basic attacks between abilities. Don’t chase a low-health Singed for long while walking through Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.laning: Don't use every Riven Q Broken Wings cast to clear minions; save casts to respond to a counterattack. Avoid and go around areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive.
Singed.phase: Later in the game, it’s difficult to break through a front line with increased health and armor alone, so choose your entry angle carefully.
Singed.teamfight: Don’t chase Singed to the end while walking through Singed Q Poison Trail. Look for an angle to enter from the side and reach the back line, and before engaging, check whether you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to escape.
Singed.watch: Avoid walking through Singed Q Poison Trail. Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor cannot escape Singed W Mega Adhesive, so go around the area it covers. Singed E Fling throws you behind Singed, so keep your distance if enemies are behind him.

Sion.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Sion W Soul Furnace or Sion E Roar of the Slayer. Avoiding Sion E Roar of the Slayer is especially important because it also reduces your armor.
Sion.escape: If Sion Q Decimating Smash is also down, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor, then stun him with Riven W Ki Burst.
Sion.fight: Dodge the charge of Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side, then approach. If Sion W Soul Furnace activates, break its shield quickly to prevent the explosion. Weave basic attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade between casts of Riven Q Broken Wings.
Sion.laning: Don’t use all your Riven Q Broken Wings charges to clear minions; save one to respond to a counterattack. Sion gains maximum health by killing units, so push the wave to disrupt his farming or make gains in another lane.
Sion.phase: Mid game is when Riven is strongest as ability haste and attack damage build up, so disrupt Sion’s farming or make gains in another lane. Later in the game, it’s difficult for Riven alone to break through a front line with increased health and armor, so choose your entry angle carefully.
Sion.teamfight: If you have no good entry angle or way to escape, don’t force a fight; push the side lane instead.
Sion.watch: When Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash, dodge to the side with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor. Avoid Sion E Roar of the Slayer, which reduces your armor and slows you. Don’t meet Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; sidestep it. If he revives with Sion P Glory in Death, create distance and reposition.

Skarner.build: Consider building magic resistance first against Skarner’s main sources of damage: Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact deal physical damage, so magic resistance alone won’t block all his damage. If you need to remove the suppression from Skarner R Impale, decide in advance whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build.
Skarner.combo: While the enemy is airborne, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile and finish them with Wind Slash when they have lost a lot of health.
Skarner.escape: Right after Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down is your chance to engage with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor.
Skarner.fight: Right after baiting out Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. Once close, stun him with Riven W Ki Burst and weave basic attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade between casts of Riven Q Broken Wings. If Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is still available, avoid engaging in a way that could push you toward a wall.
Skarner.laning: Don’t use all your Riven Q Broken Wings charges to clear minions; save one cast to respond to a counterattack. Stand away from walls to avoid Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, and trade after it’s down.
Skarner.phase: Later in the game, it’s difficult to break through a front line with increased health and armor alone, so seek early control and objectives before Skarner builds tank items.
Skarner.teamfight: Look for an angle to enter from the side or out of vision and reach the back line instead of staying face-to-face with Skarner. When Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, engage with Riven E Valor and Riven Q Broken Wings, and check whether you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to escape. At the edges of the Dragon or Baron pit, Skarner R Impale can drag you in, so don’t stand against a wall.
Skarner.watch: If Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact grabs you and slams you into a wall, you’ll be stunned, so don’t stand with your back to a wall. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval empowered basic attacks and Skarner P Threads of Vibration become more dangerous the longer you stay close and take hits, so don’t force an extended close-range fight even after dodging Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. You can’t escape Skarner R Impale with Riven W Ki Burst’s stun or a mobility ability.

TahmKench.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s healing make it hard to finish him, buy Executioner’s Calling early. Also consider armor penetration against Tahm Kench’s high armor.
TahmKench.combo: While the third hit knocks the opponent up, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile, then finish with Wind Slash once missing health has increased. Riven W Ki Burst has short range, so use it once you’re close.
TahmKench.escape: When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, look for a chance to engage, since his options for engaging and escaping are limited. If stacks have built up from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, back off first and wait for them to disappear.
TahmKench.fight: Tahm Kench E Thick Skin turns damage into a shield or healing, so avoid short trades where you hit him a little and back off. When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down and you can commit all at once, close in with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor, weaving empowered basic attacks between abilities.
TahmKench.laning: Don’t use all your Riven Q Broken Wings charges to clear minions; save one to respond to a counterattack.
TahmKench.phase: Later in the game, it’s difficult to break through Tahm Kench, whose health and armor have increased, alone, so choose your entry angle carefully.
TahmKench.teamfight: If Tahm Kench R Devour is available, account for how it will make it harder to finish the ally he’s protecting. Spread out from your allies to avoid the area knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, and when engaging, check whether you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to escape.
TahmKench.watch: If you keep getting hit by basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste will build, setting up a stun and Devour. If you’ve been hit twice, create distance and wait for the stacks to disappear. When you see Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive’s dive animation, don’t group up at the landing point; dodge the area knock-up.

Teemo.build: Teemo’s main sources of damage—Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap—deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Building attack damage afterward also strengthens Riven E Valor’s shield.
Teemo.combo: When going for a kill, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while the enemy is airborne, then use Wind Slash once a large amount of health has been lost.
Teemo.escape: After Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, if Teemo W Move Quick has also been used, close the gap with Riven E Valor and Riven Q Broken Wings. Using Riven E Valor to engage leaves you with fewer ways to escape, so consider your retreat path and whether to save the third cast of Riven Q Broken Wings.
Teemo.fight: Look for a trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Close the gap all at once with Riven E Valor and Riven Q Broken Wings, then stun him with Riven W Ki Burst once you’re close and weave in basic attacks to deal damage.
