Teemo.laning: Don’t use all your Riven Q Broken Wings charges to clear minions, and watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare stealth in bushes where you have no vision with a Control Ward or by going around.
Teemo.phase: Later in the game, don’t force a direct frontal engage; choose your entry angle carefully.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Traps in front of objectives and in narrow passages, and avoid shortcuts you haven’t checked when retreating. Enter from the side or out of vision to reach the back line, and check whether Riven E Valor’s shield and a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings for your escape will be available.
Teemo.watch: If hit by Teemo Q Blinding Dart, even basic attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade will be nullified, so stop basic attacks during the blind and use abilities or back off. Teemo E Toxic Shot applies lingering poison damage with just one basic attack, and Teemo R Noxious Trap can slow you in key paths, so check your route in.

Trundle.build: If Trundle P King’s Tribute healing makes it hard to finish him, buy Executioner’s Calling early. Build armor first against the physical damage from Trundle Q Chomp. Trundle R Subjugate reduces your resistances and deals damage based on your maximum health, so getting out of its range takes priority over building more health or resistances.
Trundle.combo: While the enemy is airborne, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile and finish with Wind Slash, which grows stronger in proportion to missing health.
Trundle.escape: A good window to engage is after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and Trundle W Frozen Domain has expired. Confirm that Trundle Q Chomp’s attack damage reduction has also ended, then close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor. Once close, stun him with Riven W Ki Burst to keep Trundle, who has no ability to create distance, within reach.
Trundle.fight: Trade briefly after Trundle Q Chomp’s attack damage reduction ends and you’re off Trundle W Frozen Domain. Weave empowered basic attacks between casts of Riven Q Broken Wings, and use Riven W Ki Burst once you’re close with Riven E Valor or Riven Q Broken Wings. If Trundle R Subjugate activates, don’t keep fighting to the end; create distance and look for another opening.
Trundle.laning: Once you’ve chipped away at Trundle’s health, immediately capitalize on it or push the wave to force him to recall so you don’t give him time to heal with Trundle P King’s Tribute. Avoid fights near river and jungle entrances where Trundle E Pillar of Ice can easily trap you.
Trundle.phase: Use Riven’s attack damage and ability haste in mid game, and later choose an entry angle instead of fighting the tougher front line head-on.
Trundle.teamfight: Check your escape options before engaging, and push the side lane if there’s no good angle to approach.
Trundle.watch: Trundle Q Chomp reduces Riven’s attack damage, so back off right after it hits and re-engage after the effect ends. Don’t fight on Trundle W Frozen Domain, and keep your distance while Trundle R Subjugate is active. Fight in open terrain so Trundle E Pillar of Ice can’t block your escape route; if a pillar appears, sidestep immediately.

Tryndamere.build: Build armor first against Tryndamere’s physical damage and critical strikes. If healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust makes it hard to finish him with a combo, buy Executioner’s Calling early. Also consider Thornmail against an opponent who relies on basic attacks.
Tryndamere.combo: When going for a kill, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while the enemy is airborne, then finish with Wind Slash once a large amount of health has been lost. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don’t use Wind Slash; let its duration run out.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down is your window to engage. Close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor and land Riven W Ki Burst. If you used Riven E Valor to engage, check whether you have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to escape.
Tryndamere.fight: Right after baiting out Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, engage with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor, then land Riven W Ki Burst once you’re close. Weave basic attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade between abilities to deal a burst of damage in a short trade. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage activates, hold your finishing attack and create distance.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, harass Tryndamere to make last-hitting difficult and limit his Fury and the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust. Don’t use all your Riven Q Broken Wings charges to clear minions; save one to respond to a counterattack.
Tryndamere.phase: Later in the game, it’s difficult to break through a front line with increased health and armor alone, so choose your entry angle carefully.
Tryndamere.teamfight: When Tryndamere R Undying Rage activates, don’t focus your damage on him; control him or create distance. Don’t go alone to defend a side lane while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available; bring more players or trade for an objective.
Tryndamere.watch: When Tryndamere P Battle Fury stacks, his critical strikes become dangerous, so create distance when you see him hitting minions to build Fury. When backing away after being hit by Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, walk backward while facing him to avoid the slow, and avoid basic-attack fights while your attack damage is reduced. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage activates, don’t pour damage into him; buy time with Riven W Ki Burst or Riven Q Broken Wings, or create distance.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s damage. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types, so one type of resistance won’t block all of it. If he sustains through fights with Udyr W Iron Mantle’s healing, buy Executioner’s Calling early.
Udyr.combo: When Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, engage with Riven E Valor if you have a chance to kill him. To finish him, use the recast of Riven R Blade of the Exile afterward to make the most of its missing-health damage.
Udyr.escape: Right after baiting out Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your window to engage with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. If you’ve already been hit once by Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun, counterattack or escape while he can’t stun the same target again.
Udyr.fight: Right after baiting out Udyr E Blazing Stampede, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor. Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, press your attack without giving him time to heal. Weave basic attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade between casts of Riven Q Broken Wings.
Udyr.laning: Udyr starts in the jungle and appears for ganks, so place vision at key paths and jungle entrances. Don’t push forward in lane when Udyr is out of sight. Don’t use all your Riven Q Broken Wings charges to clear minions; save one to respond to a counterattack.
Udyr.phase: Use your strength in mid game as attack damage and ability haste build up, and don’t try to break through the tougher front line alone later in the game.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t try to force your way through Udyr head-on when he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle. Before engaging, check whether you’ll have a cast of Riven Q Broken Wings left to escape.
Udyr.watch: Be wary of a stun right after Udyr E Blazing Stampede is activated. Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s maximum-health damage and empowered basic attacks are dangerous, while Udyr R Wingborne Storm slows and deals area damage, hindering your movement. Immobilizing effects don’t work during Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s Awakened state, so use Riven W Ki Burst after Awakened ends.

Urgot.build: Urgot P Echoing Flames, Q Corrosive Charge, and W Purge deal physical damage, so build armor first. Urgot P Echoing Flames scales with maximum health, so avoid building a large amount of health alone. Urgot has high armor, so include penetration to help Riven’s physical damage get through it.
Urgot.combo: When going for a kill, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while the enemy is airborne, then finish with Wind Slash after missing health has increased.
Urgot.escape: The moment Urgot E Disdain is down is your window to engage. If you also dodged Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, you’ll have less to worry about from slows and focused fire, so approach with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor, then land W Ki Burst.
Urgot.fight: Immediately after Urgot E Disdain is down, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings or E Valor. Once you’re close, stun him with Riven W Ki Burst and weave in basic attacks empowered by Riven P Runic Blade between abilities. Staying near Urgot for too long lets his leg cannon damage stack up, so move completely outside his short range once the trade is over.
Urgot.laning: When clearing minions, don’t use every charge of Riven Q Broken Wings; save one to respond to a counterattack.
Urgot.phase: In the late game, it’s difficult for Riven to break through a frontline with increased health and armor alone, so choose your entry angle carefully.
Urgot.teamfight: Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so staying behind your allied frontline reduces the chance that Riven gets caught directly. Before engaging, check whether you’ll have Riven Q Broken Wings left for disengaging. If there’s no opening to get close, push the side lane.
Urgot.watch: Urgot E Disdain stuns and grants a shield, so avoid its charge path and engage after it is down. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, it slows you and makes you a target for Urgot W Purge. Decide immediately whether to dodge it with Riven Q Broken Wings or E Valor as it comes in. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of Urgot’s range before your health reaches the execution threshold.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and R Last Breath. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Make sure to weave in basic attacks. When going for a kill, activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while the enemy is airborne, then finish with the recast attack that scales with their missing health.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, his knockup stacks reset, giving you an opening to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t chase deep just because he used it once. Before Yasuo R Last Breath is back, close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor, then land Riven W Ki Burst.
Yasuo.fight: First break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, then commit to a full trade. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, close in with Riven Q Broken Wings or E Valor and stun him up close with Riven W Ki Burst.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the minion wave thin near your side of the lane to limit the footholds Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use to approach. Don’t use every charge of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; save one to respond to a counterattack.
Yasuo.phase: In the mid game, fight with your ability haste and attack damage. In the late game, choose your entry angle carefully.
Yasuo.teamfight: If there’s no opening to get close, don’t force it; push the side lane.
Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo hits Q Steel Tempest twice and prepares a tornado, move out of its line and dodge to the side. Getting knocked up by the tornado can lead into the area knockup from Yasuo R Last Breath, so don’t force an engage while the tornado is ready.

Yone.build: Building attack damage first also strengthens the shield from Riven E Valor. Yone deals a mix of physical and magic damage, so don’t focus on only one type of resistance. Attack speed reduction is also an option for making Yone Q Mortal Steel take longer to become available again.
Yone.combo: When going for a kill, use the recast attack from Riven R Blade of the Exile after the enemy has lost health.
Yone.escape: Close the gap with Riven Q Broken Wings and E Valor when Yone E Soul Unbound or R Fate Sealed is down. If only one of Yone’s movement abilities is down, he can still escape with the other, so check which one remains before engaging. Once you’re close, stun him with Riven W Ki Burst, and account for the Riven Q Broken Wings you’ll need to disengage.
Yone.fight: Don’t engage first while Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado is ready. After Yone uses E Soul Unbound to engage, fight while stopping his return with the stun from Riven W Ki Burst or the third hit of Riven Q Broken Wings. Use basic attacks between abilities to make use of Riven P Runic Blade’s empowered attacks.
Yone.laning: Don’t use every charge of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions; save at least one to respond to Yone’s engage.
Yone.phase: In the late game, don’t try to break through the frontline alone; look for an entry angle from the side.
Yone.teamfight: Yone W Spirit Cleave grants a larger shield when it hits multiple champions, so spread out from your allies. Check your position so you’re not alone at the very back of the formation Yone R Fate Sealed targets.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, wait outside its range until the stacks disappear. If he uses E Soul Unbound to engage, he can deal extra damage when he returns, so create distance before your health drops. Yone R Fate Sealed knocks up and pulls in enemies in an area, so don’t stand overlapping its path during teamfights.

Yorick.build: If Yorick Q Last Rites’ healing makes it hard to finish him, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build early. Build armor first against the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and his Mist Walkers. Yorick E Mourning Mist and R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage and scale with maximum health, so be careful about building a large amount of health alone.
Yorick.combo: Activate Riven R Blade of the Exile while the enemy is airborne, then finish with Wind Slash after they have lost more health. Don’t skip empowered attacks by chaining Riven Q Broken Wings.
Yorick.escape: Engage when Yorick E Mourning Mist misses and Yorick W Dark Procession is down.
Yorick.fight: Dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist, then step forward and start a fight. If there are many graves in the area, reposition first. If Mist Walkers are on you, clear them before targeting Yorick himself. Yorick has no movement ability, so close in with Riven Q Broken Wings or E Valor, then stun him with Riven W Ki Burst.
Yorick.laning: Push the lane so Yorick can’t build graves while clearing the wave on his side, but don’t use every charge of Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions. If you dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist, step forward and farm until it’s ready again.
Yorick.phase: In the mid game, when ability haste and attack damage are building up, actively look for openings. In the late game, don’t force an engage into a frontline with increased health and armor.
Yorick.teamfight: Before engaging, check whether you’ll have Riven Q Broken Wings left to disengage. If there’s no opening to get close, push the side lane. When Yorick pressures a side lane, consider defending that side with your allies and then either regrouping with your main team or securing an objective elsewhere as a trade.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and reduces armor, so dodge its projectile before starting a trade. If the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking you, Yorick’s basic attacks can deal additional damage based on your maximum health, so create distance from Yorick himself.
